svg.text: this project = nx-remote-cache. Memory tier off: every hit is fetched from the store (S3 here).

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Memory tier on: hot artifacts up to 4 MB are kept in RAM (NX_CACHE_MEMORY_CACHE_BYTES, 256 MB default) and served without a store round trip.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Memory-tier hits are served from RAM without a store round trip, so they are shown as a number rather than a bar. Full tables: bench/RESULTS.md
